result.one_liner: ClickUp is a productivity/project-management platform (tasks, docs, goals) with a REST API for managing workspace data.

evidence.quote: Add the token to the header: Authorization: {personal_token}
Users log into ClickUp, navigate to Settings > Apps, and click "Generate" or "Regenerate" under API Token.
Free Forever, Unlimited, Business: 100 requests per minute per token
Public Beta: ClickUp's MCP server is currently in public beta, and we're actively seeking feedback

result.notes: Personal API token (pk_ prefix) is free, self-serve, never expires — obtainable by any ClickUp user via Settings > Apps, including on the free tier. OAuth2 apps also self-serve for workspace owners/admins, no formal review mentioned. Rate limits apply on free tier too (100 req/min), so not paid-gated. ClickUp also publishes an official first-party MCP server (mcp.clickup.com), in public beta, available on all plans. api_breadth marked medium based on typical ClickUp API scope (tasks, lists, folders, spaces, goals, docs, webhooks, etc. — roughly 100+ endpoints); apis.guru spec showing only 2 endpoints appears stale/incomplete and was not relied on.
